description: This is a unit test class for the EmployeeDependentService component of the OrangeHRM HRM system. It tests CRUD operations and search functionality related to employee dependents within the PIM module.

classes.name: EmployeeDependentServiceTest
classes.description: Unit test class for EmployeeDependentService, testing functionality like retrieval, saving, deletion, and search of employee dependents in the system.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes test dependencies and prepares test fixtures before each test.

methods.name: testGetEmployeeDependents
methods.description: Tests the retrieval of multiple employee dependents for a specific employee.

methods.name: testGetEmployeeDependent
methods.description: Tests retrieval of a single employee dependent identified by employee and dependent IDs.

methods.name: testSaveEmployeeDependent
methods.description: Tests saving a new employee dependent and verifying the saved data.

methods.name: testDeleteEmployeeDependents
methods.description: Tests deletion of multiple dependents for an employee.

methods.name: testSearchEmployeeDependent
methods.description: Tests searching dependents with specific filter parameters.

methods.name: testGetSearchEmployeeDependentsCount
methods.description: Tests counting dependents matching search criteria.
